text:
maria: Morning all — quick async standup.

maria: Yesterday: finished the SLO alert threshold PR and rolled to canary for batch-job latency, no regressions observed.
Blocker: seeing one recurring noisy alert from svc/batch-job-queue during scale spikes, still investigating.
Today: will tune alerting rules, add min_samples, and run a noise filter job. Ping me for CR review.

alex: Can you paste the alert rule snippet so I can eyeball it?

maria: ```yaml
alert: HighQueueLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="batch-job"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.8
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "batch-job queue P95 latency > 0.8s"
```

alex: Looks like the window is 5m and for:5m — try reducing to 2m and add min_samples: 3 to cut noise.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: high-latency detected svc/batch-job-queue — alert triggered at 1850130001, assigned to @sam

sam: On it. Checked pod metrics — GC spikes on worker-3 correlated with the alerts. I restarted worker-3; latency dropped back to baseline. Will capture a heap dump and follow up.

jonah: PR #1092 (rate-limit backoff) is ready for review, includes a fix for exponential backoff bug. @maria can you take a look when you have a moment?

priya: If noise persists we can add a suppression window in Alertmanager and a short-term silence during scaling. I can open a patch for that if y'all agree.

maria: Thanks. I'll review PR #1092 before EOD. @alex please add min_samples: 3 to the rule and reduce the evaluation window to 2m. :thumbsup:

alex: Done — pushed patch (git/abc1234). LMK if anything else.

sam: Closing loop: after the restart and the smaller eval window the alerts have been quiet for ~10m. Marking as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
